parameters.pool_rule: every eligible group of the same family and partition, except the groups of the original's split unit

frozen_encoder.score: cosine of the stored int16 unit vectors, computed with integer sums

top_10_agreement.definition: mean share of the top 10 that two baselines share, per pair

pilot_labels.warning: 2 unacceptable and 9 ambiguous labels, all drafted by a model. These numbers describe this sample only and do not establish baseline quality.

note: Rankings of untrained baselines over unlabeled pairs. A high percentile means the baseline places the sampled candidate near the top of its pool, which reflects the sampling strategy, not substitutability. The frozen encoder was pretrained elsewhere and none of its weights were updated here. Nothing here is a trained result and no human label exists.
